meta.note: Hand-entered seed data. price: 0 = free, 1 = € (under 10 €), 2 = €€ (10 to 20 €), 3 = €€€ (over 20 €). Coordinates are approximate. verified=true means price and discount were checked against the venue's or the city's own information online; verified=false means not checked yet.

spots.name: experimenta Science Center
spots.tip: Hands-on science centre on the Neckar island. Plan at least half a day and bring your student ID for the reduced ticket.

spots.name: Kilianskirche
spots.tip: The city's landmark church with its Renaissance tower, right in the centre.

spots.name: Marktplatz & Rathaus
spots.tip: Town hall with the astronomical clock. The weekly market is held on the square.

spots.name: Neckarmeile
spots.tip: Riverside strip of bars and restaurants. Best on a warm evening.

spots.name: Wertwiesenpark
spots.tip: Large park along the Neckar between the centre and Sontheim. Good for picnics and running, with a skate area and mini golf.

spots.name: Pfühlpark
spots.tip: Park east of the centre with big lawns and a small lake. Barbecues are not allowed.

spots.name: Trappensee
spots.tip: Small lake with a little castle, next to Pfühlpark. There is a beer garden beside it and a tram stop of the same name.

spots.name: Wartberg viewpoint
spots.tip: Walk up through the vineyards for the best view over the city.

spots.name: Botanischer Obstgarten
spots.tip: Free botanical fruit garden. Nicest in spring and early autumn.

spots.name: Stadtbibliothek im K3
spots.tip: City library with quiet desks, group rooms and Wi-Fi. A change of scene from campus.

spots.name: Museum im Deutschhof
spots.tip: City museum on local history and archaeology. The permanent exhibition is free; special exhibitions can cost extra.

spots.name: Kunsthalle Vogelmann
spots.tip: Changing art exhibitions in a compact gallery.

spots.name: Theater Heilbronn
spots.tip: Municipal theatre. Ask at the box office for reduced student tickets.

spots.name: Kaffeehaus Hagen
spots.tip: Café of a local coffee roastery.

spots.name: Schlossplatz
spots.tip: The central square. Sit on the lawn in front of the Neues Schloss.

spots.name: Schlossgarten
spots.tip: Long green park running from the centre towards the Neckar.

spots.name: Stadtbibliothek am Mailänder Platz
spots.tip: The white cube library. Free to enter, with study desks and a roof terrace.

spots.name: Mercedes-Benz Museum
spots.tip: Car history over several floors. Bring your student ID for the reduced ticket.

spots.name: Porsche Museum
spots.tip: Smaller than the Mercedes museum and directly at the S-Bahn stop.

spots.name: Staatsgalerie
spots.tip: State art gallery, from old masters to modern art.

spots.name: Kunstmuseum Stuttgart
spots.tip: The glass cube on Schlossplatz with modern and contemporary art.

spots.name: Landesmuseum Württemberg
spots.tip: Regional history museum inside the Old Castle.

spots.name: Markthalle Stuttgart
spots.tip: Art Nouveau market hall with food stalls from around the world.

spots.name: Palast der Republik
spots.tip: Kiosk bar where everyone stands outside on the pavement with a drink.

spots.name: Karlshöhe
spots.tip: Hilltop view over the city, with a beer garden in summer.

spots.name: Teehaus im Weißenburgpark
spots.tip: Pavilion café in a hillside park with a view over the city. Opening times change with the season, so check before you go.

spots.name: Killesbergpark
spots.tip: Large hillside park with a lookout tower in the middle.

spots.name: Fernsehturm Stuttgart
spots.tip: The original TV tower. Go up around sunset on a clear day, and show your student ID for the reduced ticket.

spots.name: Feuersee
spots.tip: Small lake with the Johanneskirche on it, in the middle of the West district.

spots.name: Max-Eyth-See
spots.tip: Lake on the Neckar surrounded by vineyards. Good for a sunny afternoon.

spots.name: Palmengarten
spots.tip: Botanical garden with large greenhouses. A good escape from exam stress; bring your student ID for the reduced ticket.

spots.name: Grüneburgpark
spots.tip: Big open park next to the university campus.

spots.name: Günthersburgpark
spots.tip: Neighbourhood park popular with locals on summer evenings.

spots.name: Chinese Garden in Bethmannpark
spots.tip: Small, quiet Chinese garden hidden inside a city park.

spots.name: Kleinmarkthalle
spots.tip: Indoor market hall. Grab lunch at one of the stalls.

spots.name: Römerberg
spots.tip: The old town square with the half-timbered houses.

spots.name: Eiserner Steg
spots.tip: Footbridge over the Main with the classic skyline view.

spots.name: Mainufer
spots.tip: Riverbank lawns. Bring your own drinks and watch the skyline at sunset.

spots.name: Main Tower
spots.tip: Viewing platform on top of a skyscraper. The reduced student ticket is sold at the ticket desk, not online.

spots.name: Städel Museum
spots.tip: The city's major art museum on the south bank of the Main.

spots.name: Senckenberg Naturmuseum
spots.tip: Natural history museum known for its dinosaur skeletons.

spots.name: Museum MMK für Moderne Kunst
spots.tip: Modern art in the wedge-shaped building near the cathedral.

spots.name: Goethe-Haus
spots.tip: The house where Goethe was born, rebuilt and furnished in period style.

spots.name: Berger Straße
spots.tip: Long street full of cafés and bars. Start at the lower end and walk up.

spots.name: Alt-Sachsenhausen
spots.tip: Cobbled lanes with cider taverns and student bars.

spots.name: Apfelwein Wagner
spots.tip: Traditional cider tavern with shared tables. Try the green sauce.

spots.name: Stadtbücherei Zentralbibliothek
spots.tip: Central city library with reading and study spaces.

spots.name: Lohrberg
spots.tip: Hill with the city's vineyard and a wide view of the skyline.
